title: Ee Bandhana
desc: An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.

title: Namma Preethiya Ramu
desc: Ramu, a singer with visual impairment, tries to earn a living for his family through his meagre income. However, his life changes when an evil man with hidden motives promises him his eyesight.

title: King of Kotha
desc: Heartbroken on being back-stabbed by his childhood friend, Raju, an influential man, runs away from his hometown, Kotha. Soon, to bring back order in the town, a police officer plots a plan.

title: Bahubali: The Beginning
desc: A tribal-raised boy learns he is Mahishmati royalty, discovers his father's bravery, and aims to overthrow the current king.
